title: Detailed paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fdf6e3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d9c8a9'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wingTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#efe0c4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wingUnder' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cbb896'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a99878'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='keelGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e6d6b8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#bda984'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow beneath for depth -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='86' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a4a6b' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- bottom keel / fuselage underside -->
  <polygon points='18,68 50,72 78,40 44,52' fill='url(#keelGrad)'/>
  <polygon points='44,52 78,40 74,44 46,56' fill='#8f7d5e'/>

  <!-- top wing (main triangle) -->
  <polygon points='18,68 78,40 62,24' fill='url(#wingTop)'/>

  <!-- wing crease highlight -->
  <polygon points='18,68 62,24 56,30 24,64' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- lower wing flap -->
  <polygon points='18,68 50,72 62,24' fill='url(#wingUnder)'/>

  <!-- crease line where wings meet -->
  <polygon points='18,68 50,72 56,64 26,62' fill='#b3a080' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='18,68 30,74 34,66 24,62' fill='#e0cfaf'/>
  <polygon points='18,68 24,62 34,66 30,74' fill='#c6b291'/>

  <!-- nose tip -->
  <polygon points='18,68 24,66 22,72' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- motion lines -->
  <line x1='6' y1='58' x2='16' y2='62' stroke='#7fc9ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='4' y1='68' x2='14' y2='70' stroke='#7fc9ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.65'/>
  <line x1='8' y1='78' x2='16' y2='76' stroke='#7fc9ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- sparkle accents -->
  <path d='M84 22 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <path d='M70 12 l1 2.6 2.6 1 -2.6 1 -1 2.6 -1 -2.6 -2.6 -1 2.6 -1 z' fill='#ffd36b'/>
</svg>
